rule.description: MCP server or MCP-related command executed
rule.info: Detects process creation events that appear to start or invoke Model Context Protocol servers or MCP tooling.
Falsepositives: Documentation searches, harmless scripts, or unrelated commands containing the token mcp.

rule.description: Runtime launched an MCP server package
rule.info: Detects Node, Python, or uv runtimes launching MCP server packages.
Falsepositives: Approved local MCP services managed by developers or IT.

rule.description: MCP filesystem server or writable filesystem connector executed
rule.info: Detects MCP servers that expose filesystem access or appear to target user or repository paths.
Falsepositives: Approved controlled filesystem MCP usage in isolated workspaces.
Detects MCP browser automation connectors, which can interact with authenticated browser sessions, web apps, or internal portals.

rule.description: MCP cloud or infrastructure connector executed
rule.info: Detects MCP connectors or commands related to cloud, Kubernetes, or Docker control planes.
Detects MCP connectors that may expose database access to an AI agent.
Falsepositives: Approved local database development or read-only analysis workflows.

rule.description: MCP SaaS or collaboration connector executed
rule.info: Detects MCP connectors that may grant AI agents access to repositories, tickets, chat, or documentation systems.
